name: locusai-local-bash
description: Allowlisted, containerized bash execution against a mounted project directory. No shell string is ever accepted -- callers supply a binary name plus an argv list, run with shell=False.

tools.name: run_command
tools.description: Run one allowlisted binary with an argv list inside the mounted project directory. No shell is invoked.

workspace_directory.title: LocusAI project directory
workspace_directory.description: The directory to mount at /workspace inside the container.
